preacher-curl.criteria: Two dumbbells, supinated grip, upper arms supported on preacher pad, stable elbows and torso, controlled curl and return.

rear-delt-fly.criteria: Seated bent-over reverse fly, torso stable, palms face inward, fixed soft elbow bend, arc out to sides without shrug or row.

straight-arm-pulldown.criteria: High pulley straight bar, slight forward torso lean, fixed slight elbow bend, lower bar in shoulder arc toward thighs and controlled return.

limits: Reuses procedural human and equipment rigs; newly rendered exercise-specific motion and timing. Simplified anatomy, hands and equipment, no full mesh collision or biomechanical certification. Device and production pending.
